paragraphs.text: Inés Cedillo Lomelí was arrested in Arrest VER-11-05 on 2011-12-21. Pacto del Faro Gris was linked to Arrest VER-11-05 on 2011-12-21. Arrest VER-11-05 occurred at Veracruz on 2011-12-21. A taxi operator with regular fares in the Veracruz port district reported that federal forces arrested Cedillo, a plaza boss for Pacto del Faro Gris known to the docks as El Tordo, outside a seafood restaurant near the customs house. The operator was parked nearby and watched the arrest, which was conducted without shots fired and with Cedillo led away in a federal vehicle.

Ignacio Treviño Salcido led Pacto del Faro Gris from 2011-02-11 until 2016-03-09. The operator characterized Treviño as the head of the pact and stated that the docks dated his control of the pact from a meeting in February rather than from the earlier founding, which the operator attributed to a period in which the three crews had not yet accepted a single leader. The reporting office notes that this dating differs from other reporting and reports it as given.

The reporting office assesses the operator as a direct witness to the arrest and as having only incidental access to the pact's leadership history. The operator added that the restaurant was closed the following day and that port workers assumed Cedillo had been informed on by a rival within the pact. The reporting office will compare the leadership date given here with other agency reporting before the discrepancy is reflected in any assessment. The individuals named in this report have appeared in prior reporting under different nicknames.
